prior: W-R70–W-R73 demonstrated brittle +1/-1 shifts with original 16-weight readouts and zero improvement from anchor-based normalizers. W-R74 first-use (original post-custody assertion failed, read-only QA passed) showed absolute phase-origin prediction on excluded source ≈0.345 against chance 0.333, making absolute phase estimation unreliable.
hypothesis: Can a fixed circular-orbit pooled sixteen-feature state representation eliminate dependence on unidentifiable global temporal origin and improve +1/-1 paired matching scores on completely withheld source without degrading intact performance?
freeze: Three fixed candidates: original features (1× compute), average features over offsets0,4,8,12 (4×), or over all sixteen circular offsets (16×), preserving cross-channel relative alignment. Fit separate 16-weight ridge for each on exactly 1728 signed samples of identical included-source development data seeds9008..9023. Select orbit4/orbit16 via minimum intact/+1/-1 score on separate included-source validation 9040..9047+9072..9079 (not heldout). Freeze before first-use on unseen xorshift source, unseen entities, seeds18240..18255, three amps, four permutations and three phase conditions. Full16 all-shift invariance is testable algebraically but not a prediction of preserved task signal.
primary: ORBIT_POOLED_READOUT_TRANSFER iff dev-selected orbit representation achieves >=0.60 accuracy for intact/+1/-1 on heldout, improves +1 >=0.07 vs frozen original, loses at most .05 intact and .05 minus1. PARTIAL_ORBIT_POOLED_READOUT_GAIN if minimum >=.55, plus1 improves >=.04 and intact/minus1 loss <=.08. Else NO_ORBIT_POOLED_GAIN. Record all 1152 original per-seed condition results, source counts and dev selection.
controls: Fixed readout 16 weights and equal 1728 signed examples, but orbit candidate 4x/16x feature-extraction compute (not equal compute)
No absolute phase label at inference, no future oracle, same relative channel alignment
Distinct first-use cohort18240..18255 not in prior documented Wingless runs
Original science artifact uploaded before postrun rubric checks, full Go regression, independent archive-only reaggregation
No paid model APIs or FORGE R32/R33, accepted refs, CKB queue/controller or production
claim_limit: Synthetic fixed orbit averaging with supervised readout and up to 16x inference feature computation; not learned raw state formation or RSI.
